properties.comment:
MTPASA_CASESOLUTION is obsolete from 2017 End of Year DM4.27 Release. 
MTPASA_CASESOLUTION holds one record for each entire solution.
Change Notice 379 announced the replacement of the MT PASA data model so all MTPASAxxx tables become obsolete, replaced by MTPASA_xxx tables.

fields.doc: Date processing of the run begins.  Generated from the solution file caseid
fields.name: RUN_DATETIME

fields.doc: Unique run id.  Generated from the solution file caseid
fields.name: RUN_NO

fields.doc: Version of the PASA solver used to solve this case
fields.name: PASAVERSION

fields.doc: Low Reserve Condition (LRC) flag for the case (1 - LRC in the case, 0 - No LRCs in the case) for capacity run
fields.name: RESERVECONDITION

fields.doc: Lack of Reserve Condition (LOR) flag for the case indicates the most severe condition in the case  (3 = LOR3, 2 = LOR2, 1 = LOR1, 0 = No LOR)
fields.name: LORCONDITION

fields.doc: Objective Function from the Capacity Adequacy run
fields.name: CAPACITYOBJFUNCTION

fields.doc: Not populated as of 2005 End of Year Release; was the demand forecast used for capacity adequacy assessment: 0 = no assessment, 1 = 10%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 90%
fields.name: CAPACITYOPTION

fields.doc: Not populated as of 2005 End of Year Release; was the demand forecast used for assessment of Maximum surplus Reserve: 0 = no assessment, 1 = 10%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 90%
fields.name: MAXSURPLUSRESERVEOPTION

fields.doc: Not populated as of 2005 End of Year Release; was the demand forecast used for assessment of Maximum Spare Capacity: 0 = no assessment, 1 = 10%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 90%
fields.name: MAXSPARECAPACITYOPTION

fields.doc: The penalty for non-zero interconnector flow
fields.name: INTERCONNECTORFLOWPENALTY

fields.doc: Date and time the record was created or modified
fields.name: LASTCHANGED

fields.doc: Discontinued in Dec 2005; was description of the constraints included in this run, being either System Normal and Planned Outage Constraints or System Normal Constraints Only
fields.name: RUNTYPE

fields.doc: Specifies the Probability of Exceedence (POE) demand forecast for Reliability LRC assessment (0 if no assessment, 10 for 10%, 50 for 50%, 90 for 90%)
fields.name: RELIABILITYLRCDEMANDOPTION

fields.doc: Specifies the Probability of Exceedence (POE) demand forecast for outage LRC assessment (0 if no assessment, 10 for 10%, 50 for 50%, 90 for 90%)
fields.name: OUTAGELRCDEMANDOPTION

fields.doc: Specifies the Probability of Exceedence (POE) demand forecast for LOR assessment (0 if no assessment, 10 for 10%, 50 for 50%, 90 for 90%)
fields.name: LORDEMANDOPTION

fields.doc: Generation Availability to be used in Reliability LRC run (either PASA or MARKET)
fields.name: RELIABILITYLRCCAPACITYOPTION

fields.doc: Generation Availability to be used in Outage LRC run (either PASA or MARKET)
fields.name: OUTAGELRCCAPACITYOPTION

fields.doc: Generation Availability to be used in LOR run (either PASA or MARKET)
fields.name: LORCAPACITYOPTION

fields.doc: UIGF POE forecast availability used for this option
fields.name: LORUIGFOPTION

fields.doc: UIGF POE forecast availability used for this option
fields.name: RELIABILITYLRCUIGFOPTION

fields.doc: UIGF POE forecast availability used for this option
fields.name: OUTAGELRCUIGFOPTION
